pt: Mais vale tarde do que nunca
say: MAIS VAH-lee TAR-jee doo kee NOON-kah
lit: Better late than never.
en: Better late than never.

pt: Devagar se vai ao longe
say: jee-vah-GAR see VAI ow LOHN-zhee
lit: Slowly you go far.
en: Slow and steady wins the race.

pt: Quem não arrisca não petisca
say: kayng nowng ah-HEES-kah nowng peh-CHEES-kah
lit: Whoever doesn't risk doesn't get a snack.
en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

pt: Mais vale um pássaro na mão do que dois voando
say: MAIS VAH-lee oong PAH-sah-roo nah MOWNG doo kee DOYS voh-AHN-doo
lit: A bird in the hand is worth more than two flying.
en: A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.

pt: Quem vê cara não vê coração
say: kayng veh KAH-rah nowng veh koh-rah-SOWNG
lit: Whoever sees a face doesn't see a heart.
en: Don't judge a book by its cover.

pt: Água mole em pedra dura, tanto bate até que fura
say: AH-gwah MOH-lee ayng PEH-drah DOO-rah, TAHN-too BAH-chee ah-TEH kee FOO-rah
lit: Soft water on hard stone hits until it pierces.
en: Persistence pays off.

pt: De grão em grão, a galinha enche o papo
say: jee GROWNG ayng GROWNG, ah gah-LEE-nyah EN-shee oo PAH-poo
lit: Grain by grain, the hen fills her crop.
en: Little by little, it adds up.

pt: Em terra de cego, quem tem um olho é rei
say: ayng TEH-hah jee SEH-goo, kayng tayng oong OH-lyoo eh HAY
lit: In the land of the blind, the one-eyed man is king.
en: In the land of the blind, the one-eyed man is king.

pt: Cada macaco no seu galho
say: KAH-dah mah-KAH-koo noo SEH-oo GAH-lyoo
lit: Each monkey on its own branch.
en: Mind your own business / stick to what you know.

pt: Quem espera sempre alcança
say: kayng ehs-PEH-rah SEM-pree ow-KAHN-sah
lit: Whoever waits always reaches it.
en: Good things come to those who wait.

pt: Diga-me com quem andas e te direi quem és
say: JEE-gah-mee kohng kayng AHN-dahs ee chee jee-RAY kayng EHS
lit: Tell me who you walk with and I'll tell you who you are.
en: You are the company you keep.

pt: Cão que ladra não morde
say: kowng kee LAH-drah nowng MOR-jee
lit: A dog that barks doesn't bite.
en: His bark is worse than his bite.

pt: Deus ajuda quem cedo madruga
say: DEH-oos ah-ZHOO-dah kayng SEH-doo mah-DROO-gah
lit: God helps whoever gets up early.
en: The early bird catches the worm.

pt: Não se pode ter tudo
say: nowng see POH-jee tehr TOO-doo
lit: You can't have everything.
en: You can't have it all.

pt: Antes só do que mal acompanhado
say: AHN-chees soh doo kee MOW ah-kohm-pah-NYAH-doo
lit: Better alone than in bad company.
en: Better alone than in bad company.

pt: O que os olhos não veem, o coração não sente
say: oo kee oos OH-lyoos nowng VEH-ayng, oo koh-rah-SOWNG nowng SEN-chee
lit: What the eyes don't see, the heart doesn't feel.
en: What you don't know can't hurt you.

pt: A pressa é inimiga da perfeição
say: ah PREH-sah eh ee-nee-MEE-gah dah per-fay-SOWNG
lit: Haste is the enemy of perfection.
en: Haste makes waste.

pt: Quem tem boca vai a Roma
say: kayng tayng BOH-kah VAI ah HOH-mah
lit: Whoever has a mouth gets to Rome.
en: If you ask, you'll find your way.

pt: Filho de peixe, peixinho é
say: FEE-lyoo jee PAY-shee, pay-SHEE-nyoo eh
lit: A fish's child is a little fish.
en: Like father, like son.

pt: Não adianta chorar sobre o leite derramado
say: nowng ah-jee-AHN-tah shoh-RAR SOH-bree oo LAY-chee deh-hah-MAH-doo
lit: No use crying over spilled milk.
en: No use crying over spilled milk.

pt: Casa de ferreiro, espeto de pau
say: KAH-zah jee feh-HAY-roo, ehs-PEH-too jee POW
lit: In a blacksmith's house, a wooden skewer.
en: The shoemaker's children go barefoot.

pt: Quem ri por último ri melhor
say: kayng hee poor OOL-chee-moo hee meh-LYOR
lit: Whoever laughs last laughs best.
en: He who laughs last laughs best.
